subject: Redwood demo & vendor intake — procurement gating and travel window
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@econixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@econixhealth.com>, procurement@econixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo & vendor intake — next steps

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday — Econix is excited to see Redwood in action. Before we lock a live demo with Marcus and the procurement team we need to complete a couple of intake items on our side:

- Signed NDA (we use a short mutual NDA)
- Vendor onboarding form (security questionnaire + SOC 2 attestation) — procurement requires the completed form in advance
- SSO and data handling notes for our security team to review

I attached the vendor form that procurement prefers (econix_vendor_form_v2.pdf). Marcus is the key decision stakeholder for the pilot but he’s traveling next week. Can we tentatively look at demo dates in early September? If you can share the NDA and any security checklist now, I’ll start the intake process and get procurement moving.

Proposed window: week of Sep 8–12 for a full demo with Marcus. If you can provide a short exec-preview (30 min) for a smaller group earlier, that might keep momentum.

Thanks — Alicia

Alicia Gomez
Sr. Product Partnerships
Econix Health
Alicia.Gomez@econixhealth.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@econixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo & vendor intake — next steps

Hi Alicia — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Attaching our standard security checklist and the NDA template to help procurement move faster (redwood_security_checklist_v1.pdf, vendor-intake-template.xlsx).

Short answers up front:
- NDA: we can return a signed mutual NDA within 24–48 hours; happy to countersign your document if you prefer.
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II attestation and an executive summary of controls once the intake form is completed.
- SSO: we support SAML2.0 and OIDC; I’ll include a one-page SSO note in the checklist.

Given Marcus’s travel and your procurement gating, I agree the most productive path is:
1) I’ll get the NDA signed this afternoon (Ben, can you confirm legal OK to sign vendor NDA with Econix?);
2) Alex can own the vendor portal intake and will upload the SOC 2 docs and complete the questionnaire once Econix returns the form;
3) We hold full demo scheduling until procurement marks intake as complete — target week of Sep 8 as you suggested;
4) In the meantime we can offer a 25–30 min exec preview for Marcus (or another exec) that focuses on high-level capabilities and time-to-value — lower risk while procurement completes checks.

Ben / Marissa / Alex — can each confirm ownership of the items above? Also, Alex, can you draft an intake response timeline and flag any open evidence that procurement typically requests so Alicia isn’t surprised.

Attachments: redwood_security_checklist_v1.pdf (security summary), vendor-intake-template.xlsx (intake file)

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Solutions — East
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Econix — procurement gating / demo timing (ownership)

Team — quick internal note to confirm owners and a suggested plan:

- Ben: legal sign-off on mutual NDA (target: today). Please confirm whether we sign Econix’s NDA or send our template.
- Alex: own the vendor questionnaire response and upload SOC 2 artifacts to Econix’s portal once they accept the form. Can you prepare an evidence checklist (1–2 days)?
- Marissa: coordinate scheduling logistics for the exec-preview and then the full demo (target Sep 8–12). Also, prepare a short 25‑minute exec slide deck focusing on ROI and performance (not technical detail).

If procurement pushes the intake timeline out, we should offer an interim exec-preview (no PII/data) to keep momentum. If Marcus is not available the week of Sep 8, we can offer alternatives the following week.

Please reply with acknowledgements and any blockers.

-- Priya
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@econixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@econixhealth.com, Marcus Li <marcus.li@econixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo & vendor intake — next steps

Thanks Priya — that approach works. I’ve looped procurement on this thread and uploaded our vendor form (econix_vendor_form_v2.pdf) — they asked specifically for:

- Completed questionnaire (we’ll accept your spreadsheet)
- SOC 2 Type II PDF or AICPA bridge letter (procurement will need the certified report)
- Network diagram and SSO details
- Data retention and deletion policy summary

Marcus is traveling (returns Sep 6). He prefers the full demo the week of Sep 8; procurement will not sign off before they receive SOC 2 and the completed questionnaire.

I’ve penciled in Sep 9 or Sep 10 as possible full-demo dates and we’ll confirm once procurement marks the intake complete. For the exec-preview, Marcus’s calendar has an open 30‑minute slot on Aug 26 at 10:00am PT — if you can do a short, high-level walkthrough (no customer data), he’s willing to join while traveling.

Attachment: econix_vendor_form_v2.pdf (their intake)

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alicia
